 Role Overview:-
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Sr. Role to Mentor the BD team pan India Level , suggestions to them and drive Pan India the company's Business Development, Key Account Management, Project Sales, and Architect/Influencer Relationships. 
 The role will be responsible for driving Mentoring the BD team , Travel Pan India, revenue growth, project acquisition, product specification, strategic partnerships, and market expansion by building strong relationships with architects, designers, developers, builders, institutional clients, and key corporate accounts.

 Identify opportunities for account expansion and cross-selling.
 Drive repeat business and improve customer retention.
 Develop strategic account plans for key customers.

 Develop and maintain a strong network of architects, interior designers, consultants, and key influencers.
 Drive product specifications and brand preference across key projects.
 Conduct product, technical, and design presentations.
 Build long-term relationships with the architect and design community.
 Identify opportunities to increase architect-driven business.
 3. Business Development & Revenue Growth
 Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.

 Build, manage, and convert a strong project pipeline.
 Generate new business through strategic networking and market development.

 Brand positioning, Event
 Content and campaigns

 Customer engagement initiatives
 Coordinate with the Product team for product offerings, customization, and project-specific requirements.
 Ensure effective coordination between Business Development, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.
 6. Pipeline & Opportunity Management
 Track the complete project lifecycle from lead generation to closure.
 Maintain strong CRM discipline and ensure timely updating of opportunities.
 Monitor pipeline health, conversion ratios, and sales velocity.
 Review opportunities regularly and identify bottlenecks affecting conversion.
 Develop accurate business forecasts based on the project pipeline.
 7. Market Intelligence & Business Strategy
 Track competitor activities, market trends, pricing, products, and emerging opportunities.
 Identify new segments, markets, and business opportunities.
 Provide strategic market insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
 Develop strategies to strengthen the company's presence in the architect, developer, institutional, and project ecosystem.
 8. Team Leadership & Capability Building
 Lead, mentor, and develop the Business Development / Key Account Management team.
 Set clear objectives, targets, and performance expectations.
 Drive team productivity, accountability, and performance.
 Develop team capabilities through coaching, guidance, and knowledge sharing.
 Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure achievement of business objectives.

description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Business Development Executive to join our sales team in Ahmedabad. You will generate new business through outbound outreach to companies in India and abroad, qualify leads, support the sales process through to closure, and manage ongoing client relationships. 

 Key responsibilities 
 Identify and research potential clients through LinkedIn, databases, networking and industry platforms. Generate leads through cold email, LinkedIn outreach and cold calling. Qualify leads by understanding their requirements, budget, timeline and decision process. Schedule and attend introductory calls and capability discussions with prospects. Coordinate with the technical team on estimates, proposals and solution details. Follow up on leads and maintain regular communication until closure. Maintain accurate records of leads, activities and pipeline in the CRM. Manage relationships with existing clients, including renewals, upselling and day to day coordination. Coordinate with internal delivery teams for smooth client onboarding. Work towards agreed targets for qualified meetings and pipeline. 

 Required skills and qualifications 
 Minimum 2 years of experience in business development or sales, preferably in IT services or software. Hands on experience with outbound lead generation, including cold calling, cold email and LinkedIn outreach. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Experience using CRM tools to manage pipeline and activity. Working knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator and lead generation tools. Basic understanding of software development services such as web and mobile applications, ERP and system integration. Ability to work across time zones with international clients. 

 Good to have 
 Experience selling to clients in the US, UK or Europe. Experience with email sequencing or sales automation tools. Familiarity with AI tools for prospect research and drafting outreach.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in B2B sales, recruitment/staffing services, or HR solutions, with the ability to independently identify prospects, generate leads, engage decision-makers, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into long-term client relationships. Key Responsibilities Drive new-business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within the assigned international region. Identify and build a target-account database based on industry, geography, company size, and hiring potential. Generate leads independently through LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, cold calling, email outreach, referrals, networking, industry events, and strategic partnerships. Connect with key decision-makers, including CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Founders, Procurement Teams, and Business Heads. Promote recruitment and staffing solutions, including permanent recruitment, executive search, contract staffing, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), international recruitment, and volume hiring. Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to proposal submission, negotiation, contract finalisation, and closure. Negotiate commercial terms, recruitment fees, service agreements, and Master Service Agreements (MSAs) while maintaining profitability. Collaborate with recruitment, delivery, operations, and finance teams to ensure successful client onboarding and fulfilment of hiring mandates. Develop long-term client relationships, generate repeat business, and identify cross-selling and account-expansion opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and regular follow-ups. Achieve agreed monthly revenue and business development targets following the applicable ramp-up period. Region-Specific Responsibilities 1. Business Development Manager – US & Canada Develop new business opportunities across the United States and Canada. Build relationships with North American employers across IT, healthcare, engineering, manufacturing, finance, logistics, construction, and professional services. Understand client requirements related to direct-hire recruitment, contract staffing, executive search, RPO, and project-based hiring. Navigate client procurement processes, MSP/VMS requirements, vendor onboarding, and staffing agreements where applicable. Generate opportunities for permanent recruitment, contract staffing, executive search, RPO, international recruitment, and volume hiring. Understand employer procurement processes, recruitment vendor onboarding, replacement terms, exclusivity requirements, and commercial expectations. Manage proposals, fee negotiations, service agreements, and client objections to convert prospects into active hiring mandates. title: Assistant Area Manager
description:
Job Description: Assistant Area Manager (Lab Water Sales and Service) Company: Borosil Scientific Limited
 Industry: Industrial Equipment / Scientific & Laboratory Equipment
 Location: Ahmedabad
 Experience Required: 6-10 Years
 Website: https://www.borosilscientific.com/ Gender: Male Only 
 About the Company Borosil Scientific Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer and supplier of laboratory glassware, scientific instruments, laboratory equipment and consumables, with over six decades of industry expertise. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of scientific solutions, including laboratory water purification systems, serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, healthcare and industrial laboratories. Borosil Scientific focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality products and technical solutions to customers across India and international markets. 
 Role Purpose The role will support and grow the Lab Water business in Pune and the assigned territory while ensuring that customers receive dependable support after the sale. The role involves understanding laboratory requirements, recommending suitable solutions, converting opportunities, coordinating installations and staying connected with customers throughout the life of the equipment. The person should be comfortable discussing business with decision-makers and equally willing to work with users and service colleagues at the customer site. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Territory Sales and Business Development Prepare and execute the annual territory plan for revenue, order intake, gross margin, new-account acquisition and installed-base expansion in line with the business plan. Map and develop target accounts across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CRO and CDMO organisations, healthcare and diagnostics, academic and government research, food and beverage, chemicals, environmental testing and other quality-control laboratories. Generate qualified opportunities through direct customer coverage, referrals, channel partners, exhibitions, seminars, application discussions and systematic follow-up of enquiries and leads. Understand the customer's application, required water grade, daily and peak demand, feed-water quality, available utilities, installation conditions, documentation expectations and lifecycle-cost considerations before recommending a solution. Prepare clear techno-commercial proposals and budgetary offers, negotiate within delegated authority and secure orders with appropriate price, margin, payment and delivery terms. Provide accurate technical and customer inputs to the commercial or tender-support team whenever their assistance is required. Maintain a healthy opportunity funnel, update CRM or sales trackers, submit accurate forecasts, and review conversion risks and recovery actions with the reporting manager. Monitor competitor activity, market pricing, application trends and customer feedback; provide structured inputs for product positioning, sales strategy and portfolio improvement. 
 2. Application and Solution Selling Position Type I, Type II, Type III and combined Type I and II systems according to the customer's analytical, life-science and general laboratory requirements. Explain relevant performance parameters such as conductivity, resistivity, total organic carbon, microbial and particle control, flow rate and storage capacity without making unsupported performance or compliance claims. Work with application, product and service specialists to select appropriate configurations involving reverse osmosis, electro-deionisation, UV or TOC options, ultrafiltration, storage and recirculation, dispensers, pre-treatment and point-of-use consumables. Conduct product presentations, site surveys, demonstrations and technical discussions for users, laboratory heads, QA and QC teams, engineering, procurement and senior decision-makers. Translate customer needs into an accurate bill of materials and clear scope of supply, including accessories, consumables, installation prerequisites and post-sale support. 
 3. Installation and After-Sales Service Plan and coordinate installations with the customer, logistics, service and product teams; confirm site readiness for feed water, drainage, power, space and operating conditions before the visit. Perform or supervise installation, commissioning, functional checks and user handover in accordance with approved procedures and the agreed scope. Provide user training on operation, routine care, water-quality monitoring, sanitisation, consumable replacement, alarm handling and good recordkeeping. Attend preventive-maintenance and breakdown calls, diagnose faults systematically and restore equipment safely within committed response and resolution timelines. Maintain complete service records, equipment history, installed-base data, visit reports, parts usage and closure evidence; obtain customer acknowledgement for completed work. Identify and convert opportunities for annual maintenance contracts, comprehensive service contracts where offered, consumables, cartridges, filters, spares, upgrades and replacement systems. Plan preventive-maintenance schedules and consumable replacement cycles, monitor contract renewals and support customers proactively to improve uptime and system performance. Escalate recurring, safety-related or technically complex failures with complete diagnostic information and coordinate corrective action with product, quality and engineering teams. Maintain service tools, test equipment and spare parts assigned to the territory, and ensure their safe custody, calibration status where applicable and optimum utilisation. 
 4. Customer and Commercial Management Act as the primary territory contact for Lab Water customers and coordinate internal ownership until enquiries, complaints, installations and service issues are closed. Build relationships with users, influencers, consultants, procurement teams and channel partners while maintaining professional, ethical and fact-based communication. Support timely collections, resolve commercial documentation gaps and manage credit exposure in coordination with finance and the reporting manager. Review customer feedback, repeat complaints and service trends; implement recovery actions and share improvement inputs with the relevant functions. 
 Candidate Profile Educational Qualifications Degree or diploma in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry, Biotechnology or Microbiology. 
 Experience Requirements Typically 6-10 years in laboratory-water purification, scientific instrumentation, analytical equipment, life-science equipment or a comparable technical B2B field role, including meaningful exposure to both sales and after-sales service. 
 Required Technical Knowledge Laboratory-water grades and applications, including Type I, Type II and Type III water. Purification technologies and components such as pre-treatment, reverse osmosis, deionisation or EDI, UV treatment, TOC reduction or monitoring, ultrafiltration, storage, recirculation, pumps, valves, sensors and dispensers. Water-quality parameters including conductivity, resistivity, TOC, microbial load, particles and endotoxin-sensitive applications. Basic electrical, electronic, plumbing and mechanical fault diagnosis; safe use of service tools and test equipment. Techno-commercial proposals, product demonstrations, CRM or pipeline management, service documentation and customer complaint handling. 
 Behavioural Competencies Customer focus with the ability to listen carefully, diagnose needs and take ownership through closure. Commercial judgement balanced with technical accuracy, serviceability and lifecycle value. Structured problem-solving and calm decision-making at customer sites. Clear written and verbal communication with laboratory users, technical teams and senior stakeholders. Planning discipline, follow-through, data-based reporting and accountability for commitments. Collaboration across sales, service, product, operations and support functions. Integrity, safety awareness, learning agility and willingness to remain hands-on in the field.

Key Skills: Relationship,Business development,Territory sales,Site,Commercial,Coordination,Installation,Application

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 Neutec Engineering Solutions LLP is looking for motivated and target-driven Sales Business Development Executives to join our team and support business growth in the US market.
The role involves identifying potential clients, conducting outbound sales activities, generating qualified leads, building relationships with prospects and scheduling meetings for our BIM and digital engineering services.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify and research potential clients across the US market, including architectural firms, engineering consultancies, MEP contractors, general contractors and laser scanning companies. Conduct outbound sales activities through cold calling, email outreach and LinkedIn prospecting. Connect with key decision-makers, including business owners, directors, project managers and BIM/VDC managers. Introduce Neutec's BIM and digital engineering services and identify potential business opportunities. Qualify prospects based on their service requirements, project pipeline and outsourcing needs. Schedule meetings and coordinate follow-ups with interested prospects. Maintain accurate lead information, communication history and sales activities in the CRM. Follow up with prospects consistently to nurture relationships and convert opportunities. Coordinate with the internal team for meetings, proposals and further sales discussions. Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales activity and meeting targets. Prepare regular reports on outreach activities, responses, meetings and qualified opportunities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. 1 to 2 years of experience in sales, business development, lead generation or outbound calling. Experience in cold calling, email outreach and LinkedIn prospecting is preferred. Good verbal and written communication skills. Confidence in speaking with international prospects and business decision-makers. Basic knowledge of CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets and sales prospecting tools. Ability to research companies, identify opportunities and qualify potential clients. Strong follow-up, organisational and relationship-building skills. A proactive, self-motivated and target-oriented approach. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 Candidates with experience in international sales or US-market outreach will be preferred. Experience in B2B sales, IT services, engineering services or outsourcing is an advantage. Familiarity with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io or similar platforms is beneficial. Candidates based in Ahmedabad or nearby areas will be given first priority. Willingness to work according to US business hours as required. 
 Working Schedule 
 Working Days: Monday to Friday Weekly Off: Saturday and Sunday Work Mode: Work from Office Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat 
 The daily shift timing will be aligned with US-market business hours. 
 Performance Expectations 
 Consistent outbound calling, email outreach and LinkedIn prospecting. Generation of qualified leads and sales opportunities. Meetings scheduled with relevant US-based prospects. Timely follow-ups and accurate CRM updates. Contribution towards the team's quarterly revenue and client acquisition targets. 
 About Neutec Engineering Solutions LLP 
Neutec is a multidisciplinary BIM and digital engineering services company supporting clients across international markets. Our services include BIM modelling, MEP BIM modelling, Scan to BIM, BIM coordination, clash detection and construction documentation.
